description: Save a new Brain memory when the user explicitly asks to remember, save, or store something. Store either one singular fact or one short Markdown mini-doc (headings, lists, bold, links, code, and Mermaid diagrams) up to about 800 words. Use one memory for one coherent fact or note; do not paste a long document. A new memory that contradicts or restates an older one replaces it; the older one stays in version history.
